info.title: Rusty Weather API
info.description: Self-hosted model and observation catalogs, exact-time queries and analytics, native satellite delivery, bounded jobs, controlled sharing, and authenticated storm-analysis operations.

post.description: Resolve a finite geographic bbox against one exact snapshot/grid, then return its minimal native rectangular envelope with cropped lat/lon arrays, exact projection metadata, and a cell mask. Longitude is an eastward arc; west > east crosses the antimeridian and -180..180 selects the globe. Surface fields and explicit pressure levels are read from intersecting native chunks only; no full-grid coordinate payload or vertical reduction is emitted.

get.description: Return one complete forecast plane as binary f32 for the named run generation. The whole native grid is returned: no cell ceiling, no downsampling, and no truncation by the synchronous query budgets that bound the JSON window routes. Because the URL pins snapshot_id and grid_hash it names one immutable body, which is what makes the long-lived immutable cache directive true. The payload uses the same versioned RWOBF32 container as observation planes under its own media type. Surface variables are stored as lossless zstd1_f32; pressure levels are stored as zstd1_affine_i16 and are therefore dequantized approximations, so the exact stored codec ships in x-rw-model-codec rather than letting an f32 payload imply losslessness. No palette, semantics, or interpolation hints are emitted: model variables carry no stored display metadata, and the authoritative styling inputs (selector, kind, levels_hpa, available_slots) stay on /v1/models/{model}/runs/{run}/variables.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Exact stored variable filename, including the required .bin suffix

parameters.name: expected_snapshot_id
parameters.description: Required. The snapshot_id this plane must belong to; a mismatch fails instead of silently following an atomic republication of the same run name

parameters.name: expected_grid_hash
parameters.description: Required. The grid_hash this plane must belong to

parameters.name: level_hpa
parameters.description: Omit for a surface2d variable; supply one exact stored pressure level for a pressure3d variable. There is no default level and no implicit vertical reduction

Cache-Control.description: Always public, max-age=31536000, immutable; the URL's snapshot/grid guards make the body immutable

ETag.description: Strong snapshot, slot, variable, and level validator

x-rw-model-codec.description: Exact stored codec: zstd1_f32 (lossless surface) or zstd1_affine_i16 (dequantized pressure level)

x-rw-model-level-hpa.description: Present only for a pressure level; absent on surface planes

x-rw-nodata.description: Non-finite transparency contract for absent cells

x-rw-valid-unix.description: Valid time of the plane in Unix seconds

post.description: Decode one caller-supplied authoritative NOAA/RPG NEXRAD Level III message 58 (NST/STI tracking) or message 62 (SS/NSS structure) product with the pure-Rust decoder. The response preserves product identity, ROC specification references, transport identity, validation notices, and an explicit geometry statement: message 58 supplies centroids/tracks but no polygons; message 62 supplies centroids/structure attributes but neither polygons nor tracks. Every response is authenticated, private, and no-store.

FederationOriginDescriptorDoc.description:
Runtime parsing uses the exact closed DTOs in `rw-community-protocol`.
These document wrappers keep the HTTP surface legible without maintaining
a second canonical-signing implementation in the server crate.

preferred_origin_id.description: Optional preference among origins already admitted by signed policy.

request.description: Exact canonical ShareRequest; mutable aliases are forbidden.

latitudes.description: Row-major cell-center latitudes. Null means the coordinate is unavailable.

longitudes.description: Row-major cell-center longitudes. Null means the coordinate is unavailable.

provenance_provider.description: Exact upstream/provider identity; empty means the caller supplied none.

values.description: One value per grid cell. Null means missing/no coverage and is stored as NaN.

GeoPoint.description: Geographic position shared by every contract in this crate.

GeographicWindowResponse.description:
Schema `rw.query.geographic-window.v1`. Projection carries the exact
serialized rustwx-core GridProjection tagged union or null.

status.description:
`ready` and `degraded` both mean the core server can accept traffic.
Degraded identifies optional data followers only; HTTP 503 is reserved
for a failed core probe or an explicit operator readiness gate.

JobArtifactDoc.description:
Immutable JSON artifact emitted by one of the currently registered job
submission families.

ModelPlaneBinaryDoc.description:
One complete model forecast plane in the same versioned `RWOBF32` f32
container as observation planes: little-endian header (`RWOBF32\0`, version,
`nx`, `ny`, `valid_unix`, variable/unit lengths, reserved word), the
variable and unit strings, then exactly `nx * ny` row-major `f32` cells.
Non-finite cells are absent values and must remain transparent.

stale_after_seconds.description:
Effective freshness window for this product: its configured
per-product override, or the worker-level `stale_after_seconds`.

snapshot_id.description:
Canonical validated `rw-query` identity for the complete run snapshot
containing this frame. Snapshot-bound analysis requests must echo it.

product_base64.description: Canonical base64 for one supplied Level III message 58 or 62 product.

site_hint.description:
Optional four-character radar identifier used only when transport
metadata does not identify the site.

geometry_statement.description:
Explicit statement of geometry supplied by NOAA and geometry absent
from the product; downstream displays must retain it.

truncated.description: True only when the caller supplied `limit` and more runs existed.

ObservationGridBinaryDoc.description:
`RWOBGRID` binary grid geometry. See the observation capabilities response
for the versioned media type.

ObservationPlaneBinaryDoc.description:
`RWOBF32` calibrated observation plane. Missing/non-coverage cells are
encoded as non-finite values and must remain transparent.

OriginCatalogHealthStatus.description:
Coarse, address- and identity-free state suitable for readiness/operator
status. It intentionally omits paths, model names, run IDs, and errors.

validation_notices.description:
Explicitly reported operational oddities that are safe to isolate.
An empty list means every relevant declared offset was consumed.

i_quarter_km.description: Signed eastward coordinate in exact quarter-kilometre units.

j_quarter_km.description: Signed northward coordinate in exact quarter-kilometre units.

turn_local_addr.description:
This participant's own provider allocation returned by TURN. It is
transport-private, never a host/server-reflexive/direct candidate.

ReplicationOwnerResponse.description:
The caller's replication-domain owner identifier. It is derived from the
already authenticated principal and reveals neither the bearer token nor
any other owner's identity.

pending_retirements.description: Terminal, non-public generations awaiting bounded physical cleanup.

RunDescriptorResponse.description: Public run identity and exact stored time-axis summary.

source_revision.description: BLAKE3 content identity of the complete required-channel native frame.

SourceProvenanceResponse.description: Sanitized union of resolved providers represented in a run.

StoredObservationFrameRefDoc.description: Artifact schema written when an accepted observation job succeeds.

expected_grid_hash.description: Exact native-grid identity required by this request.

expected_snapshot_id.description: Exact immutable generation required by this request.

source.description: Scientific source identity that must agree with the stored grid.

coordinates.description: RFC 7946 longitude/latitude coordinate arrays, including contour holes.

oneOf.description:
Prefer a compatible active compiled-Rust model, then honestly fall
back to deterministic contours when no such model is executable.

rights_reference.description: License, contract, or internal approval used for auditing.

direction_from_degrees.description: Meteorological direction from which the storm moves.

geometry.description: Whether geometry is authoritative, derived, and/or absent upstream.

TemporalGridResponse.description: Exact tagged union emitted by the temporal-grid reducer and job artifacts.

TimePointResponse.description: One exact stored valid time. Internal store filenames are intentionally not exposed.

history_in_packet_order.description:
Packet order is preserved. Product 58 does not encode an exact time for
each past point, so `valid_at_unix_ms` remains `None` rather than being
invented from scan cadence.

bearer_auth.description: Token supplied by RW_API_TOKENS or RW_API_TOKEN_FILE

federation_origin_auth.description: Dedicated per-origin token; ordinary BowEcho API tokens are rejected

operations_admin_auth.description: Dedicated operations admin token, or a general API token only when the default-off legacy elevation gate is explicit

operations_read_auth.description: Operations read, write, ingest, or admin token; response is private and no-store
